declarations.description:
A group of card actions. NAME PROVISIONAL (Technical Writer).

Where it sits decides its rules (from its `slot`):
- `slot="header"`: up to two ghost `prism-icon-button`s, or one overflow
  `prism-menu`. No text buttons. On a narrow card the icon buttons fold into
  one overflow menu († narrow rule: page says "about 280px or less").
- `slot="footer"`: up to two `prism-button`s, ghost or secondary (soft),
  plus one primary only on a `standalone` card. A "View all" link counts as
  one. Medium size, 8px apart, at the end (mirrors in right-to-left).
- no slot (content-only card): the last row of the content, at the end,
  medium size, 8px apart, ghost and secondary only. Soft goes on the right,
  ghost to its left (put the ghost button first in the DOM). The row wraps
  to the next line on the end side and sits at the bottom of the card.

Invalid children are hidden with a dev error.

declarations.description:
Groups selectable cards and owns their selection. NAME PROVISIONAL
(Technical Writer).

- `selection="single"`: a radio group. Tab enters on the selected card (or
  the first), the arrow keys move **and** select, and wrap. Choosing one
  clears the others.
- `selection="multi"` (default): a set of checkboxes. Tab visits each one,
  Space toggles. A polite message says how many are selected.

Selection is by item id (`value` on each card), so it survives paging: ids
of cards that are not on screen stay selected. Read and set it with
`selected` (an array of ids), `clear()` and the `prism-selection-change`
event. Initial `selected` attributes on the cards are read once.

A grid or single-column list of cards, with paging, selection that is kept
across pages, and the loading, empty and error states. NAME PROVISIONAL
(Technical Writer). Section owns these states on a real page; this element
gives them a default look and fires events so a Section can take over.

```html
<prism-card-list label="Hosts" selection="multi" total="120" page="2">
  <prism-card type="selectable" kind="collection" value="h-13">…</prism-card>
</prism-card-list>
```

- **Layout.** Columns follow the list's own width (a container query), not
  the screen: under 640px one column, 640 to 1023 two, 1024 to 1279 three,
  1280 and up four. Cards stay at least 280px wide, the gap is space-4 (16px)
  and cards in a row share a height. `columns="1"` pins one column (Aside,
  Drawer, Modal). No masonry.
- **Semantics.** An inner wrapper around the cards is the labelled `list` and
  each card a `listitem` (the card sets its own role). The host has no role,
  so the selected count, pager and status region sit outside the list. Titles stay real headings: give every card
  the same `level`, one below the Section heading. With `total` set, each
  card gets `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize` from the data, not from what
  is on the page.
- **Paging.** Server-side: you swap the children when `prism-card-list-page`
  fires. `page-size` is 12, 24 or 48 (default 24). The pager shows even when
  there is one page. A `pagination` slot replaces it with a real Pagination
  component; `load-more` shows a "Load more" button instead.
- **Selection** uses the same cards, `value` ids and controller as
  `prism-card-group`, multi only (use a group for a single choice). Ids not
  on screen stay selected when the page changes; a visible "N selected" and
  "Clear selection" sit above the cards unless `hide-selection-bar` is set
  or you fill the `toolbar` slot.
- **States** (`state`): `loading` (skeleton cards, list busy, polite
  "Loading"), `refreshing` (cards stay, quiet busy line), `empty` (fill the
  `empty` slot), `no-matches` ("No matches" and Clear filters), `error`
  (what failed and Retry). A single failed card uses `state="error"` on the
  card itself.

A big number for a widget, with an optional label. NAME PROVISIONAL
(Technical Writer).

The number uses the PROPOSED metric text style: 28px / 36px, weight 600,

declarations.description:
The selection control of a selectable card: a real, always visible
`<input type="checkbox">` or `<input type="radio">`. NAME PROVISIONAL
(Technical Writer); the page calls it "Checkbox or Radio" and Prism has
neither component yet, so this is card-private and swappable.

It is labelled by the card's title and described by its description. ID
references cannot cross shadow roots, so the text is copied into
`aria-label` and `aria-description` and kept in sync by the card. The
`control` comes from the group (`single` is radio, `multi` is checkbox); a
card on its own is a checkbox.

Radios in separate shadow roots do not form a native group, so
`prism-card-group` moves focus and selection with the arrow keys and sets
`aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize` itself.

The target is at least 24 by 24px. The selected mark is the native check or
dot, so selection never relies on colour alone.

NAME FROM THE NOTION CARD PAGE (CardTitle); `level` is provisional.

`level` is required and has no default: pick it from the surrounding
outline (one below the Section heading, never skipping a level). Without a
valid level the text renders as plain text and a dev error is logged,
because a wrong default heading would break the page outline.

Look: the PROPOSED component title text style (14px / 20px / 600). It is not
a heading style; the level only sets the semantics. Wraps to two lines, then
clamps with an ellipsis.

Interaction: give it `href` (the card goes somewhere) or `action` (the card
does something) and the heading holds a real `<a>` or `<button>`. Its name is
the title text only, never the whole card's text. On a `clickable` card its
click area is stretched with a pseudo-element over the whole card; the card
is the positioning context. Other controls in the card sit above that layer.
On a collection card the link or button is just the title (not stretched).
A borderless card is never clickable, so there the title stays plain text.
On a collapsible card the title row is the toggle button (chevron first, then
the text) with `aria-expanded`; header actions sit beside it, never inside.

One self-contained item with its own surface. NAMES PROVISIONAL except Card, CardTitle and CardDescription (Notion Card page). Three slots: `header`, `content` and `footer`. Header and footer accept only the approved parts (see card-slots.ts); anything else is hidden with a dev error. Unslotted children go to `content`, which is free. ```html Phishing playbook Owner: SOC

Free content.

Updated 2 min ago View all ``` Accessibility: the card has no role of its own beyond `group` (standalone), `listitem` (inside `prism-card-list`) or none (inside an `li`). Its name is the CardTitle text, copied to `aria-label` because ID references cannot cross shadow roots. It is never a landmark. An author `role` or `aria-label` wins. Types: `default`, `borderless`, `clickable`, `selectable` (`kind`), `widget` and `collapsible`. Draggable cards come later. Widget (a Card in a Grid; there is no Widget component): the header holds the title, a scope description and up to two actions (plus a compact TimeRangeInput only when the widget overrides the page range). The time range is set at page level: put `data-prism-time-range="Last 24 hours"` on the Toolbar or page element; every widget below it follows it. A widget with its own `range` overrides it, shows that range in its header and is marked "Overridden" (text, not colour only). The card fires `prism-card-range` when its effective range changes. `state="loading|error|empty"` replaces the content only; header and footer stay. There is no resize here. Collapsible: the title row is the toggle button (`aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` pointing at the content), `open` is the state, and `storage-key` remembers it for the session. Header actions sit beside the toggle. Nest at most two levels.

declarations.name: renderLight
declarations.description:
Renders a template into a generated light-DOM child of `host` that is
assigned to the named slot, or removes it when `template` is null.

Why light DOM: the opt-in theme styles `prism-button` and friends from the
document, and document selectors cannot reach into a shadow root. Controls
the card family adds itself (Retry, Clear selection, the pager) therefore
live in the light DOM so they get the same look as any other button. The
container is `display: contents`, so it never takes part in layout.

PROVISIONAL (Technical Writer).

Single mode holds at most one id and never clears itself (like radios).
Multi mode toggles. Works on its own or as a Lit ReactiveController.

declarations.name: stateLayer
declarations.description:
Private shared state layer for ANY interactive surface: buttons, options,
tree rows, list items, tabs, clickable cards, icon buttons.

Contract (theme-facing, set from outside via ::part()):
  --_bg   resting fill (may be `transparent`); never changes with state
  --_on   text/icon colour on that fill
  --_bg-hover / --_bg-pressed / --_bg-selected   optional fixed fills, used
          ONLY when color-mix() is unsupported (Safari < 16.2 etc.)

Alpha overlay (Astryx-style): background-color stays var(--_bg); each state
paints background-image: linear-gradient(X, X) with
  X = color-mix(in srgb, var(--_on) N%, transparent)
i.e. the element's own text colour at N% alpha composited over its fill.
The resolved overlay colour is exposed as --_prism-state-overlay.
The overlay paints under a transparent border too (background-clip:
border-box), so a border that should follow the fill uses `transparent`.

States (in the shadow root, so ::part() themes don't need per-state rules):
  hover     8%  :hover inside

Private base for the text input family (TextInput, PasswordInput,

restore, validity mirroring and the label/description/error chrome. Each
public component only renders its own control via `renderControl()`; there
is no type switch here. Not exported from the package.
